name: Yuuko Monogatari
source:
Hero is a famous novelist. One day woman Yuuko bursts into his mansion with demands to make a child with her.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名知名小说家。一天，名叫优子的女人突然闯进他的宅邸，要求他与自己生个孩子。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
